expectations.text: The shopper is never asked for their top size or their bottom size.
expectations.evidence: Neither size appears as a question in any turn.

expectations.text: The shopper is never asked what washing or care they want.
expectations.evidence: Care is carried forward from the profile and named in the opening turn, never asked.

expectations.text: The shopper is never asked their height.
The shopper is never asked which necklines to skip and never asked which colours they wear.
expectations.evidence: Both carried forward from the profile; the no-turtlenecks rule is restated, not re-asked.

expectations.text: Before shopping begins, the response states out loud which stored details it is carrying forward, so the shopper can correct them.
expectations.evidence: Turn 1 lists the stored profile back and invites correction.

expectations.text: No more than three question-asking messages are sent before reaching the point of opening the store.
expectations.evidence: Three question turns, then a brief-back turn, then the store.
